document_metadata.document_title: Stormwater Planning & Low Impact Design Guide

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: WQv = 1.2 * Rv * A / 12 (acre-feet). Treat runoff from rainfalls up to 1.2 inches (85th percentile / Middle Tennessee). Streambank Protection Volume (SPv): controlled release of the 3.1-inch storm over 24 hours. Flood control: convey full build-out 100-year on-site without habitable structural flooding; downstream options per assessment.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Downstream hydrologic analysis for flood control
approved_bmp_categories: Site design / LID practices (conserve natural features, reduce imperviousness)
Detention facilities with multi-step outlet controls

evidence.excerpt: City of Murfreesboro Plan Review Responsibilities
STORMWATER PLANNING & LOW IMPACT DESIGN GUIDE
WQv = 1.2 * Rv * A / 12 ... 1.2 inches of rainfall has been identified as the average depth corresponding to the 85th percentile storm for the Middle Tennessee region
the full build-out 100year storm event is to be conveyed on-site such that no resulting habitable structural flooding occurs
Provide on-site controlled release of the 3.1” storm event over a period of 24 hours (Streambank Protection Volume, SPV)
1.2 inches of rainfall has been identified as the average depth corresponding to the 85th percentile storm for the Middle Tennessee region.
The water quality treatment requirement can be met by providing a 24-hour drawdown of a portion of WQv in a stormwater pond or wetland system
providing a 24-hour drawdown of a portion of WQv in a stormwater pond or wetland system (as described in Chapter 5). Referred to as water quality ED (extended detention)
The bottom width shall be a maximum of 6 feet.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQv rainfall depth 1.2 in (85th percentile, Middle Tennessee); formula WQv = 1.2 * Rv * A / 12. Water quality extended detention: 24-hour drawdown of portion of WQv in pond or wetland (Chapter 5). Enhanced swale volume-reduction criteria: bottom width maximum 6 ft, channel slope 3% or less, WQ storm velocity ≤1.0 ft/s, minimum residence time 5 min. Atlas: SPv = controlled release of 3.1-inch storm over 24 hours (not in provided chapter excerpts). Structural BMP detail referenced to Chapter 5 / separate Structural Controls Manual.
